title: Three Autumns and One Short Basket
subtitle: 天气气候 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）
meta: 主题语境：天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）　|　核心词汇：winter　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 winter 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1993 the farmer ① spent the winter that no child in the field would have recorded, and he said the spending was the whole of the autumn. The ② winter, meaning the season itself and not the basket, ran three autumns and stayed unrecorded in the book; a winter, he said, is the only thing in a field that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ winter in that field had the same short basket beside it, and the ④ winter at the far fence, meaning the seed they kept for the children to sow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A winter, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the farmer said the recording is the part that fills three autumns.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the winter was the whole of the matter, meaning the hardship and not the season. The ⑥ winter, meaning the hardship and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; winter, he said, is either something you spend or the only word that means both a season and a hardship. He said the hardship is the part they remember.

By 1998 the ⑦ winter had become a line in an almanac, and the almanac had become an argument about the short basket. The ⑧ winter of the whole thing, the farmer wrote in September, was one field and three autumns of recording; winter, he said, is either the seed at the far fence or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ winter I remember is the season recorded in the almanac, which closed in 2000 and is still recorded as the quietest in the field. A ⑩ winter, my mother said in 2002, is the only season that improves by being recorded; every winter, she said, is a hardship that has agreed to look like a season. She said the hardship was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 冬天（指田垄里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 冬天（指那个冬天本身，与小小的竹篮相对）
C. 固定搭配：spend the winter 过这一个冬天
D. n. 冬天（指留给孩子们播的那一把）
E. n. 冬天之事（抽象总称，指一处田垄的冬天之事）
F. n. 冬天（指农事历里写到、被记载的那一个）
G. n. 冬天、苦寒（指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 苦寒（抽象总称，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: spent the winter that no child in the field would have recorded
The winter, meaning the season itself and not the basket
the winter at the far fence
the winter was the whole of the matter
the winter had become a line in an almanac
The winter of the whole thing
A winter, my mother said in 2002

answers.why: spend the winter 意为“过这一个冬天”，1993 年那位农人把田垄里没有一位孩子肯记载的一个冬天做了一遍。
winter 意为“冬天”，指那个冬天本身而不是小小的竹篮，它经过了三个秋天而在簿子上没有被记载。
winter 意为“冬天”，指田垄里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一只小小的竹篮。
winter 意为“冬天”，指最远那道篱边的留给孩子们播的那一把，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
winter 意为“冬天、苦寒”，指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个苦寒就是那件事的全部。
winter 意为“苦寒”，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个冬天，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
winter 意为“冬天”，指农事历里写到、被记载的那一个，到 1998 年这一个成了农事历里的一行。
winter 意为“冬天之事”，农人九月写道，整件事的冬天之事是一处田垄和三个秋天的记载。
winter 意为“冬天”，我记得的是农事历里记载过的那一个，2000 年收完了，至今仍被说成田垄里最安静的一个。
winter 为抽象总称，母亲 2002 年说，冬天是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的冬天。
